title: Forum Edge AI Announces $94.4 Million Definitive AI Cloud Services Compute Agreement with Fireworks

body_markdown:
PALM BEACH, Fla.


, Oct. 26, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- Forum Markets, Incorporated ("Forum" or "the Company") (Nasdaq: FRMM), an innovator in sourcing and operating cash-generating assets in AI infrastructure, commercial aerospace and AI-powered consumer finance, today announced that Forum Edge AI LLC ("Forum Edge"), the Company's joint venture with Edge Node Inc., has entered into a definitive agreement with Fireworks, the specialized intelligence platform, for a 36-month reservation of Nvidia B300 GPU capacity at its existing, powered data center facility in Dallas.


The agreement carries a combined total contract value of approximately $94.4 million, reflecting GPU capacity and associated CPU management node fees payable over the 36-month term. Fireworks has provided a substantial prepayment deposit, which will be credited against fees due across the term.


The GPUs are expected to be deployed at Forum Edge's Dallas data center in late December or early January. The Dallas facility is one of the sites included in Forum's initial AI infrastructure investment and features existing permits, power access and physical infrastructure.


"This agreement is an important proof point for our AI infrastructure strategy and reflects our focus on bringing revenue generating GPUs to market quickly in a modular manner," said McAndrew Rudisill, chairman and chief executive officer of Forum Markets, Incorporated. "We have a strong partnership with Fireworks and are excited about our growth trajectory as we scale our AI infrastructure business. This is the first finalized contract Forum Edge is executing against and the first of several exciting partnerships we expect to deploy into our unique footprint."


Fireworks provides inference, training, and routing that help enterprises deploy and scale generative AI applications in production. The company was most recently valued at approximately $17.5 billion, with backers including Nvidia, Atreides Management, Index Ventures and TCV. Fireworks' scale and the caliber of its financial backers reflect the type of high-quality counterparty Forum has identified in its off-take partnerships.


Hosted AI, Inc., through its AI commercialization network/mesh and platform, facilitated the relationship between Forum Edge AI and Fireworks.


The agreement represents Forum Edge's first contracted customer commitment and supports Forum's broader strategy of deploying disciplined, risk-adjusted capital into cash-generating AI infrastructure assets.


**About Forum Markets, Incorporated**


Forum Markets, Incorporated (Nasdaq: FRMM) is an innovative company that sources and structures cash-generating assets with attractive risk-adjusted returns in aerospace, AI, and AI-powered consumer finance. The company draws on proprietary origination pipelines and strategic co-investment partnerships to scale its portfolio and generate durable operating income. Forum integrates traditional asset management principles with hands-on operational execution as it builds a new framework for how real-world assets are owned, managed, and monetized. For more information, please visit forum-markets.com.
